components.name: Identity
components.description: Name, player name, alignment, biography, and personality.

components.name: Physical Description
components.description: Appearance, pronouns, gender, age, height, weight, eyes, skin, hair, and additional details.

components.name: Player Notes
components.description: Private or player-facing notes about the character.

components.name: Creation Provenance
components.description: The selections and inputs from which the initial character state was produced.

components.name: Species
components.description: The selected species and its choices.

components.name: Background
components.description: The selected background and its choices.

components.name: Languages
components.description: Languages the character can communicate with.

components.name: Experience
components.description: The character's accumulated Experience Points.

components.name: Classes and Levels
components.description: The starting class and current level in each class.

components.name: Subclasses
components.description: The subclass selected for each applicable class.

components.name: Character Choices
components.description: Selected options for choices introduced by character advancement.

components.name: Ability Scores
components.description: Strength, Dexterity, Constitution, Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma.

components.name: Saving Throw Proficiencies
components.description: Abilities whose saving throws add the character's Proficiency Bonus.

components.name: Skills and Expertise
components.description: Skill proficiency and Expertise ranks.

components.name: Armor and Weapon Proficiencies
components.description: Armor training and weapon proficiencies.

components.name: Tool Proficiencies
components.description: Tools with which the character has proficiency.

components.name: Weapon Masteries
components.description: Weapons whose mastery properties the character can use.

components.name: Creature Type
components.description: The character's creature type.

components.name: Size
components.description: The character's current Size.

components.name: Movement Speeds
components.description: Walking, climbing, swimming, flying, and burrowing speeds.

components.name: Senses
components.description: Special senses and their ranges.

components.name: Defenses
components.description: Damage and condition resistances, immunities, and vulnerabilities.

components.name: Species Features
components.description: Features granted by the selected species.

components.name: Background Feat
components.description: The feat granted by the selected background and its choices.

components.name: Class Features
components.description: Features granted by class advancement.

components.name: Other Feats and Boons
components.description: Feats and boons not represented by the species, background, or class feature components.

components.name: Spellcasting Sources
components.description: Sources of spellcasting and the ability used by each source.

components.description: Cantrips and known or prepared spells grouped by source.

components.name: Spell Slots
components.description: Maximum and expended spell slots grouped by level and slot kind.

components.name: Item Instances
components.description: Owned item instances, quantities, and container relationships.

components.description: Whether owned item instances are carried, held, worn, or stored.

components.name: Attunement

components.name: Currency

components.name: Hit Points
components.description: Maximum, current, and Temporary Hit Points.

components.name: Hit Dice

components.name: Death Saves
components.description: Death save successes, failures, and stability.

components.description: Active conditions, their sources and durations, and Exhaustion level.

components.name: Limited-use Resources
components.description: Limited-use resources and their recharge rules.

components.description: Whether the character currently has Heroic Inspiration.

components.name: Active Effects
components.description: Applied temporary effects and their remaining runtime state.

components.name: Feature State
components.description: Active modes and mutable state belonging to granted features.

components.name: Attack Options
components.description: Display-ready attacks derived from features, spells, and equipped items.

components.name: Derived Statistics
components.description: Proficiency Bonus, Armor Class, Initiative, Passive Perception, saving throws, and skill modifiers.

components.name: Spellcasting Statistics
components.description: Spell attack bonuses and save DCs calculated for each spellcasting source.
